title: Gnars runs entirely on Base
lede: Gnars is a community-owned action-sports DAO running its whole stack on Base — daily auctions, onchain governance, a transparent treasury, NFT drops, swaps, and staking. Chain id 8453, end to end, since day one.

auctions.title: Daily auctions
auctions.desc: One Gnar at a time: the daily auction that funds the treasury and mints membership, Nouns-style.

governance.title: Onchain governance
governance.desc: Proposals, voting, queueing, and execution through the Nouns Builder governor — every decision settles on Base.

treasury.title: Transparent treasury
treasury.desc: Every asset, inflow, and DeFi position readable onchain — and when a price can't be read, the page says so instead of printing a zero.

droposals.title: Droposals
droposals.desc: NFT drops proposed, voted, and executed by governance, with revenue splits verified onchain.

swap.title: Swap
swap.desc: Token swaps on Base via the 0x API, straight from the site.

staking.title: Staking
staking.desc: Back Gnars riders through yield vaults, and back the Gnars Builder subnet on Morpheus with MOR — both live on Base.

underHood.aa: Account abstraction with sponsored gas — smart accounts by default, so a first-timer's vote or bid costs them nothing.
underHood.login: Social and email login next to every major wallet — built for skaters, not just crypto natives.
underHood.farcaster: Farcaster mini-app integration — the auction and stake flows run inside the feed.
underHood.mobile: Mobile-first: every DAO feature works on a phone.

culture: What Gnars brings to Base is an audience crypto doesn't reach on its own: skate, BMX, and surf culture, funding real riders and real videos through a DAO that actually executes onchain.
liveTitle: Don't take our word for it — this is the live product
liveDesc: The sections below aren't screenshots. They're the same live components the site runs in production — auction, governance, swap, and rider staking.
